caption:
Your contact form can't tell a browser from a buyer.

Name, phone number, "tell us about your project." Every submission looks identical until you pick up the phone and find out which ones were ready to spend money.

The Black Arrow platform replaces that form with a quiz funnel. It asks budget, timeline, and urgency before the lead reaches your inbox, then scores each answer so you know who to call first.

The platform texts qualified leads back in seconds and books them straight into your calendar. No more working through a list to find the three that mattered.

Try it on your own funnel for 14 days, free, no card required.
